what: `assert_step_completion_sentinels` still requires each `.completed/step-*` token inside that step's anchor slice, but the plan relocates many sentinels into foreign host fences
scenario_or_breakage: After SKILL.md folds sentinels, checks for 1e, 1d.5, 2a.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4b, and 5d will fail even when `assert_folded_sentinel_writes` passes; implementers may “fix” tests by weakening folded ordering instead of relocating step-local grep
suggested_fix: Update `assert_step_completion_sentinels` to skip host-absorbed steps (delegate to `assert_folded_sentinel_writes`) or resolve tokens via the plan’s host map; keep step-local grep only for steps that still self-write (5b, 3b, Gate-B-bypass triple writes, postplan `step-2b`/`step-2b.5`, etc.)
